WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_orders) AS overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.avg_ratio,
    gs.distinct_orders,
    ga.overall_avg
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN group_average ga
  WHERE gs.distinct_orders > ga.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(distinct_orders) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(distinct_orders - overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_groups

assumptions.assumption: feerate is expected to be positive (non-zero) for valid fee rate data
